name: @pokebedrock/wiki
description: Content repo powering the PokéBedrock documentation site.

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run lint:links && npm run check:generated
scripts.lint:frontmatter: npm run build:scripts && npm run lint:frontmatter:run
scripts.lint:images: npm run build:scripts && npm run lint:images:run
scripts.lint: npm run build:scripts && npm run lint:md && npm run lint:frontmatter:run && npm run lint:images:run
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:links
scripts.build:search: npm run build:scripts && npm run build:search:run
scripts.check:generated: npm run build:search && git diff --exit-code -- build/search-index.json build/search-indices.json build/content/en/pokemon-manifest.json build/content/en/moves-manifest.json build/content/en/move-learners-manifest.json build/content/es/pokemon-manifest.json build/content/es/moves-manifest.json build/content/es/move-learners-manifest.json
